snippet.title: Version "Luna V" "Homeward, He Who Caught the Wind" Trailer | Genshin Impact #GenshinImpact #Varka
snippet.description:
Version "Song of the Welkin Moon: Variation" "Homeward, He Who Caught the Wind" Trailer | Genshin Impact

Familiar skies, familiar faces, and unfamiliar stories...
People often say that the further you go, the more important it is to remember where you started, and know your way home.
"However, winds change their course."
Blowing toward where they are needed most, at the moment they are meant to arrive.
